t: Look at it, Doug. I saved it. A whole day. Yesterday me would be so proud.
Coo.
One quiz question first. Then pudding. From one, two to four, eight. Across three, up six...
Coo. Coo!
I don't need the helmet. Three over six. One half!
Why is it ALWAYS the duck pond?
The answer was two. Entrance attempt: four. Application accepted.
Application? I didn't apply for...
Coo.
Welcome, entrants. One student. One pigeon. The entrance is closed. There are nine floors. The way out is down.
Who said that? Where's the pond?
The pond is the entrance. You have arrived at it four times. The management took this as interest.
Those were ACCIDENTS!
They were wrong answers. I was there for all four.
You can TALK?
I have always been talking. You have not been listening.
The pigeon is not on the application. The pigeon may leave at any time.
You jumped in after me.
You forgot your helmet. It is a safety matter.
He left a pudding. Marcus would never leave a pudding.
Mr. Dunmore? Have you seen this before?
(quietly) It is a school night. Go home.
Before floor one, entrants are assessed. Four questions.
Four questions. Easy.
Complaint one: your confidence.
You are observed. Observers: one class. The observers will also be assessed. On your own. No talking.
